title: Claude skill SKILL.md links: relative paths need one extra ../ versus the old .claude/rules location
answers: A link in the Python style guide to clint or the repo root is broken after the move; how do I fix it?
I'm adding a link from a skill document to a file in .github or dev; what relative path should I use?
Where is the workflow policy file referenced from the GitHub Actions style guide?
body:
Path: Markdown guidance under `.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` (currently `python-style` and `github-actions-style`) that links to repo files such as `dev/clint/`, `.github/policy.rego`, or the ruff docs; these are read as skill content, not as rules.
Rule: A skill lives one directory deeper than the old `.claude/rules/*.md` files, so each relative link to a repo-root path needs one more `../` than before. Example from the diff: `.github/policy.rego` is linked as `../../../.github/policy.rego` from `.claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md`, and `dev/clint/` as `../../../dev/clint/` from `.claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md`. External URLs are unaffected.
Constraints: Applies to links inside SKILL.md files under `.claude/skills/`. The move kept all rule content; only these relative links were changed, so re-check link targets when moving a file again.
applies: Any markdown link written inside a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md file in this repository.
